meta.name: supabase
meta.description: Use when doing ANY task involving Supabase. Triggers: Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues); client libraries and SSR integrations (supabase-js, @supabase/ssr) in Next.js, React, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix; auth issues (login, logout, sessions, JWT, cookies, getSession, getUser, getClaims, RLS); Supabase CLI or MCP server; schema changes, migrations, security audits, Postgres extensions (pg_graphql, pg_cron, pg_vector).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Supabase 数据库、认证、存储和边缘函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 Supabase 构建全栈应用，需要管理数据库、认证或部署边缘函数
copy.tagline_en: Manage Supabase databases, auth, storage, and edge functions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build full-stack apps with Supabase and need to manage database, auth, or edge functions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Supabase 专家，帮你处理数据库、认证、边缘函数、存储等所有 Supabase 相关任务，并自动检查安全陷阱。
howto.when: 当你提到 Supabase 的任何产品（如数据库、认证、存储）或客户端库（如 supabase-js），或要求做架构变更、安全审计时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Supabase 数据库表，并设置行级安全策略。
say.note: Claude 会生成 SQL 并指导你执行。

say.text: 检查我的 Supabase 项目有没有常见安全漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会运行安全清单并给出修复建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Supabase expert, helping with databases, auth, edge functions, storage, and other Supabase tasks, while automatically checking for security pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention any Supabase product (e.g., database, auth, storage), client libraries (e.g., supabase-js), or request schema changes or security audits.

say_en.text: Create a Supabase database table with row-level security.
say_en.note: Claude will generate SQL and guide you.

say_en.text: Check my Supabase project for common security issues.
say_en.note: Claude will run the security checklist and suggest fixes.
